name: Scout
description: Scout is a self-hosted server, network, and device monitor with distributed agents, infrastructure health history, and network mapping.

notes.text: Open http://<IP>:8080 after installation. Read the initial setup token with: grep '^SCOUT_SETUP_TOKEN=' /opt/scout/.env | cut -d= -f2-
Scout and PostgreSQL run as Docker containers. Persistent data lives in the scout-server-data and scout-postgres Docker volumes; include both volumes in backups.
This helper exposes Scout over plain HTTP on port 8080. Use it only on a trusted network or place a TLS reverse proxy in front of it before remote access.
